author: petr1petr
body:
it used to be next to impossible - even when you had 20+ refineries and fed them with ortanite or other rare mats and did fill it daily.. 

BUT - guilds appeared - together with guild shops - and thats the best source. you can buy any material - it may take time for it to appear. so, just do guild content to gain guild currency that may be used for material purchase.

I do towers - and buy mats for tower shards - so it all depends on how fast can you get guild currency

  
as for the other replies:

"they have farmed the mats previously" - no way - that can take you maybe to some AL40-AL50

"fishing + refineries" - thats basically "guild currency" - but I dont like to fish, plus towers gives also exp, orns, drops and also some random mats - refineries - yes, that partially works, but see comment below 

"buy in shops and dismantle for refineries" - sure, you can do it - BUT - I rather spend my time hunting - so I gain not only materials, but also orns, gold, exp, good items.. so I would rather run horde dungeon, instead of checking shops for cheap stuff - also if we talk about refineries - it is kind of important to know, that cheap materials will return much less new materials compared to using rare materials - and again, you would need a LOT of refineries plus luck to gain desired materials - in guild shop, you buy only what you want.

BTW: I know few people with really high ascend - all they talk about is, how fast they can clear towers.. I dont think that it is some kind of coincidence :)

author: Sywnth
body:
Currently AL 95 

I try to always have my 40+ refineries working. (2 restocks per day with simple materials would give you aprox. 1200k for each material monthly if my calculations are correct) You can buy and dismantle items from grand market for materials, restock as needed. 

Farming proofs of anguish is what helps me the most when I'm stuck on a certain matarial. (Boss horde on 25+ anguish)

Sometimes, when it takes to long for a material to appear on anguish guild, I buy them via traveller's guild trials too. (You'll probably need Sirus on your team)

I do not run towers bc I hate them. But I heard they help a lot too.

author: KevineCove
body:
Fishing and towers are the most efficient ways to get mats from guilds, Traveler's Guild is the most efficient way to get Shrine of Luck for endless orn runs.

Having officer status in a kingdom allows you to push past a lot of locks (pure draconite, solarite, titanium, balorite, avalon ore, realm ore, or cursed ortanite, although farming too much cort will drain a LOT of kingdom orns.)

Towers are additionally useful because of the random mats you get for clearing a floor, as well as it being possible to acquire most mats from the mobs themselves. After mats you can get from shops, kingdom raids, and tower mobs are taken into account, there are surprisingly few mats that can lock you without having a clear actionable way to farm for them (I believe vampiric ore and eyestone are a couple exceptions to this, though lesser balorite appears in pretty low quantities from tower mobs.)

Moral of the story is if you want a really high ascension level, get a 50F tower and do it every day, though if you're gunning for 100AL you'll probably want multiple towers.

author: shuijikou
body:
Before guilds are introduced, most people i know are around 40al, and 50 al is already rare, but last year they introduced guild shops, so als are massively inflated, i spend one year to go from 40 al till now 151 al, mainly anguish and tower, if needed also grinding on fishing and trialing,

I can get 2500 anguish proofs per day if i wanted to, 1500 proofs casually, 5×50 towers per day that's 150-200k shards 

[this is the link i use to check on material on each guilds,](https://proof.fqegg.top/)


And i also having 100 refineries, buy all the draconite material equipments from shop and dismantle them to feed the refineries, that's about 200 all random materials per day

author: phoenixmatrix
body:
Be constantly doing guild stuff and buying rare materials even if you don't currently need them, so you have them when you do.

Also towers and memeories. Tower floor rewards, as well as memory rewards using double amenities, helps a lot.
